Note: core.illegal is mapped to signal 'illegal' and core.misaligned to 'out_open'; neither leaves the chip, so Quartus will
prune the logic that only drives them. Only result[31..0] (= alu_result) is a real output.
main decoder: case on opcode / funct3 / funct7
(branch AND (f3(2) XOR zero XOR f3(0))) OR jump
misaligned = mem_access AND ((size="01" AND addr_lo(0)='1') OR (size="10" AND addr_lo/="00")) — a misaligned load/store is squashed: neither register nor memory is written.
else → rd ; sign_x = msb AND NOT funct3(2)
